messages:
maria-partnerships: Need a short, operational play for issuing marketplace credits to partners on short NDA timelines (30-45d). CFO wants clear guardrails.

sarah-sales: This would unblock many SI-led POCs. Key blockers: legal NDA + finance approval.

simon-finance: We can pre-authorize up to $25k per partner for a 45d window if partner is registered and NDA + SOW referenced. Require a tag in the private offer for tracking.

liz-partner-ops: Suggest flag `partner_accel=true` on offer metadata; partner portal checklist (NDA, PO, use-case) triggers auto-issue for pre-approved partners.

jon-eng: Runtime needs target SKUs and expiry so we can cap billing and route Hosted vs Dedicated. Example: offer payload should include offer_id, partner, partner_accel, credit_amount, expiry_ts, target_skus.

simon-finance: Also add simple fraud rules: pause if >80% consumed in 72h or if consumption hits disallowed SKUs.

maria-partnerships: Marketing asks: co-marketing eligibility if partner uses >=50% of credit before expiry and signs co-marketing NDA.

liz-partner-ops: I'll build the checklist UI and add webhook to finance. ETA Wed.

sarah-sales: Great. If we can get a 1-pager by EOW, sales can start using it.

maria-partnerships: I'll draft the one-pager and drop it here when ready.
